content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element. 2. The site follows the two: S3-err leaves the failure a value below the envelope and S4-own leaves refusing to the envelope, so production sits with the invocation that wrote the node and rendering with the envelope; S2-write-fail fixes that a failed write refuses. Fail if the claim moves either — name it.
content.rationale: The refusal's production site is where the node-write failure meets the failure shape and the refusal authority; the gate forces the site to answer to both without re-deciding either.
